data.body:
RCA / investigation result — NOT A BUG (no descriptions lost).

Scope: 38 Jira-channel tickets (tag imported:reconciler-bootstrap); 17 currently
have blank descriptions.

Method: examined the full rebar event history (tickets branch) for every blank
ticket, and the Jira changelog (read-only) for the substantive/oldest ones.

Findings:
1. rebar side — all 17 blank tickets carry description="" from their very first
   reconciler CREATE event (the bootstrap import); no later CREATE/EDIT/SNAPSHOT
   event in their history ever held a non-empty description. Nothing was blanked
   in rebar; there is no prior value to recover from git history.
   Checked ids: jira-reb-{747,748,777,810,854,914,915,1066,1072,1162,1369,1427,
   1561,1745,1936,2372,2711}.
2. Jira side — changelogs for REB-747, REB-748 and REB-914 contain NO "description"
   field item at all (only status/labels/priority/resolution). A description that
   had been set and later cleared (e.g. an outbound clobber) would appear as a
   "description" changelog item; its absence shows Jira never held a description
   for these issues. All three still read description=null today.
3. The reconciler DOES capture descriptions when Jira has them: e.g. jira-reb-1001
   imported a 67-char description at CREATE, and jira-reb-1160 gained its body via
   later edits — so the empty imports are faithful, not a dropped-field bug.

Conclusion: these older Jira issues were genuinely created without a description
body. No en-masse loss occurred in either rebar or Jira, so there is nothing to
recover. No rebar code defect is implicated and no Jira mutation is warranted.

Residual note (not evidenced, no fix made): outbound_field_diff._suppressed_by_inbound
suppresses a local-empty description from clobbering a non-empty Jira body only
while the last-synced baseline still carries the description key (local==baseline).
That guard held for every ticket here (no clobber observed). Flagging only as a
latent-path observation for future hardening; it is out of scope for this ticket
and unsupported by any lost-description evidence.
